objective: Freeze the manager-only CFR-168 post-composition lifecycle so one exact accepted integrated revision must pass full Close, reproducible source-bound release evidence, isolated installed reversals, canonical and real-repository Dogfood, authoritative synchronization, KGI/KPI finality, and final capability re-advertisement with fresh post-mutation evidence.

risk.rationale: This packet controls acceptance of cross-runtime composition, release provenance, installed mutation safety, capability truth, authoritative issue closure, and the final development KGI. A stale subject or false pass would multiply into the next frozen roots.

disallowed_actions: Launch or change status to ready before exact accepted Python/Rust compositions, every successor, the integrated SHA, the installed runner, and the held capability commit are committed into both packet files
Author or opportunistically repair product behavior under this lifecycle packet; only the separately accepted final capability re-advertisement commit may be applied as a product mutation
Merge a whole candidate branch, recovery worktree, WIP commit, interrupted transcript, or duplicate product range
Treat candidate-only, predecessor, stale-review, stale-install, or pre-capability evidence as evidence for a changed revision
Close CFR-168, CFB-136, or CFB-138 or advertise final coverage before terminal-SHA Close, Install, Dogfood, and KGI/KPI evidence pass
Allow a reviewer to approve a revision they authored or composed
Mutate a real-repository read-only dogfood subject or edit Algorithm source, tests, documentation, or configuration to make Dogfood pass
Ignore, downgrade, or route away a same-root defect, evidence-integrity failure, capability overclaim, authority drift, or flaky release gate
Claim that local build provenance is trusted or supply-chain reproducibility evidence
Run overlapping heavy builds or retain duplicate disposable targets after compact evidence is committed when resource guardrails would be crossed
Delete user-owned changes, worktrees, caches, repositories, or evidence

non_goals: Implement or refactor remaining CFR-168 product behavior
Review devcontainer, CI, host setup, agent wrappers, packaging design, or unrelated later roots
Change Algorithm implementation, tests, documents, or configuration
Provide trusted-builder or dependency supply-chain attestation
Authorize CFR-169 through CFR-173 or CFB-133 before this root reaches terminal Retrospect
Convert activity counts, model approvals, or generated artifacts into KGI achievement

invariants.statement: Every terminal claim names one exact commit, tree, patch digest, clean status, release binary digest, installed path, and dogfood subject.
invariants.falsification_test: Change any source, test, corpus, schema, documentation, capability declaration, binary, or dogfood subject after evidence capture and require the affected stage and all downstream evidence to become stale.

invariants.statement: The post-composition subject contains only independently accepted Python, Rust, successor-surface, and manager conflict-resolution ranges.
invariants.falsification_test: Insert a WIP, rejected candidate, branch-tip-only, duplicate recovery, unresolved review, or unreviewed conflict commit and require Close entry to fail.

invariants.statement: Python, Rust, shared conformance, source/project/AI documentation, diff integrity, boundary, scale, complexity, and exact-subject review gates all pass together.
invariants.falsification_test: Remove one runtime, one selected production surface, one exact boundary, the 1x/3x/10x curve, the literal oracle, or the independent High decision and require source Close to remain a non-terminal candidate.

invariants.statement: An independent High reviewer accepts the exact subject and exact complete evidence after composition and after the final capability mutation.
invariants.falsification_test: Reuse a predecessor review, let an author self-approve, alter one byte after review, omit a required log digest, or return anything but exact ACCEPT and require review freshness to fail.

invariants.statement: Two isolated clean builds at the same exact source and toolchain produce matching binary hashes and complete source-bound provenance.
invariants.falsification_test: Change source inputs, HEAD, lock/toolchain, build inputs, binary bytes, or one build digest and require Install entry to fail without selecting the preferred output.

invariants.statement: Every installed reversal and dogfood command resolves to the temp-prefix binary whose digest equals the accepted release digest.
invariants.falsification_test: Prepend a stale binary, replace the installed file, invoke a source helper, or change PATH and require the active-path/hash preflight to fail before the case runs.

invariants.statement: The installed binary preserves exact/minus-one/plus-one, 1x/3x/10x, typed diagnostic, no-partial-response, no-mutation, cleanup, and authority invariants on every selected surface.
invariants.falsification_test: Run the accepted installed corpus with a limit-plus-one, CFB-136 mutation, CFB-138 1201-descendant upload, expired deadline, response overflow, and metrics toggle; any success, partial output, debt, drift, or semantic difference blocks Install.

invariants.statement: Canonical Algorithm Dogfood uses the exact installed binary and real-repository probes are read-only with frozen before/after authority hashes.
invariants.falsification_test: Edit Algorithm inputs, use a different binary, produce an unexpected Algorithm authority transition, or change any real-repository Git/CodeFire authority byte and require Dogfood to fail.

invariants.statement: Every new finding is identified, reproduced, owned, classified, routed, and either resolved with fresh downstream evidence or explicitly admitted as a distinct non-blocking issue.
invariants.falsification_test: Leave an observation untracked, label a same-root finding unrelated, use an environment incident as a pass, or infer no-new-finding from silence and require Retrospect to fail.

invariants.statement: Final decision-work capability coverage is not re-advertised until all predecessor lifecycle gates pass, and that re-advertisement is the last product mutation.
invariants.falsification_test: Expose final coverage earlier, apply an unreviewed declaration, mutate product after it, or retain pre-mutation evidence and require terminal status to be withdrawn.

invariants.statement: Issue ledgers, root map, plan, history, limitations, disposition index, recovery ledger, review evidence, capability payload, and KGI/KPI final record agree on the exact terminal subject and zero same-root residual.
invariants.falsification_test: Change one status, count, root, dependency, evidence reference, capability field, KGI value, record lineage, or final provenance and require canonical documentation and AI-contract validation to fail.

invariants.statement: Heavy builds and gates are serialized, durable evidence precedes cleanup, and only manager-created disposable outputs may be removed.
invariants.falsification_test: Overlap heavy gates across the resource ceiling, retain duplicate target trees without need, delete user-owned state, or lose a completed gate before its digest is committed and require the lifecycle to pause and record an incident.
